purpose: Goofy alien and UFO design exploration for Mayhem Meadows. Concept reference only; these boards are not runtime models or textures.

concepts.A: Mint visitor with a bent antenna and purple tunic
concepts.B: Lavender visitor with a yellow utility vest
concepts.C: Peach three-eyed visitor in teal overalls
concepts.D: Lanky turquoise visitor with eye stalks and coral shirt

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original alien character concept sheet for Mayhem Meadows, a cheerful low-poly third-person 3D cartoon driving sandbox.
Primary request: four distinct goofy, friendly alien designs that would fit alongside the game's simple block-bodied townspeople, chunky cars, pastel buildings and faceted trees. They should look like comically incompetent visitors who could cause playful town mischief, never frightening.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory studio background, four roomy equal panels in a 2 by 2 grid, no panel borders, minimal soft contact shadows.
Style/medium: restrained low-poly 3D game model renders with visibly flat-shaded polygon faces, primitive-based construction, chunky box limbs, low-sided rounded heads, matte flat colors, no outlines, no realistic skin or elaborate textures. Modest browser-game asset complexity rather than smooth high-end animated-film sculpture.
Subject: A: short mint-green bean-shaped alien, oversized faceted oval head, two small offset dark eyes with curious raised brows, tiny sideways grin, one bent ball-ended antenna, small purple work tunic and cream chunky shoes; trying an overconfident thumbs-up. B: broad lavender pear-shaped alien with a huge head blending into a small body, big widely spaced eyes, tiny mouth in a bewildered O, small yellow utility vest and oversized cream boots; awkward cheerful wave. C: squat peach-orange three-eyed alien, all three eyes uneven in size with dark friendly pupils, broad goofy smile with one small square tooth, simple teal overalls and tiny mitten hands; proud hands-on-hips stance. D: lanky turquoise alien with a rounded cuboid head, two short floppy eye stalks, a sheepish grin, coral short-sleeve shirt, thin block limbs and outsized trainers; stooping slightly to fit the lineup.
Composition/framing: full body three-quarter front views, each design equally prominent and individually separated with generous padding. Strongly different silhouettes, large readable features at third-person gameplay distance. Small unobtrusive panel letters A, B, C, D only.
Lighting/mood: bright gentle daylight-like studio light, simple ambient shading, cheerful Saturday-morning cartoon mischief, approachable to children and adults.
Color palette: desaturated mint, lavender, warm coral, teal, cream and butter yellow, dark blue-gray facial features; match a sunny pastel coastal toy town.
Constraints: original characters, easy to rebuild using boxes, low-poly spheres and cylinders, clearly extraterrestrial but charming, simple eyes with visible pupils, large expressive brows and simple mouths. Not plush toys or infant mascots. No horror, no menacing black almond eyes, no sharp teeth, no claws, no weapons, no slime or gore, no realistic muscles, no greebles, no dramatic sci-fi environment, no logos, no watermark, no extraneous text.

concepts.C: Lavender saucer with a tall dome and chunky thruster pods
concepts.D: Yellow-and-teal utility saucer with storage box and satellite dish

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original flying saucer vehicle concept sheet for Mayhem Meadows, a cheerful low-poly third-person 3D cartoon driving sandbox.
Primary request: four distinct goofy UFO flying saucer concepts, readable as playful alien vehicles in a pastel coastal town with chunky blocky cars, faceted trees and simple geometric characters. Make them look like delightfully unreliable little flying cars, not threatening invasion machines.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory studio background, four roomy equal panels in a 2 by 2 grid, no panel borders, hovering just above soft oval ground shadows.
Style/medium: low-poly 3D game asset renders, visibly flat-shaded polygon faces, simple low-sided discs, cones and domes, chunky primitive construction, matte painted panels and simple dark teal cockpit glass, minimal surface detail. Keep complexity plausible for a small procedural Three.js browser game, not a glossy cinematic toy render.
Subject: A: classic compact mint-and-cream saucer with a broad flattened faceted disc rim, small teal bubble canopy, squat little yellow bumper lamps, one crooked antenna, three stubby landing feet folded close to the body; cheerful slightly wonky proportions. B: coral-and-butter-yellow pancake saucer, very wide low disc, off-center small dark teal canopy, an exaggerated thick soft bumper, three lopsided round exterior running lights and a short bent aerial; the design feels like an alien economy runabout. C: lavender-and-cream doughnut-rim saucer with an upright low-poly dome cockpit, thick circular hull and three big chunky teal thruster pods tucked underneath, small orange indicator lights; tubby and buoyant, clearly still a flying saucer. D: butter-yellow-and-teal utility saucer, shallow faceted bowl hull and broad saucer lip, small squat cockpit with two simple flat windshield panes, a chunky rear storage box integrated into the circular body, three short splayed feet and a ridiculous tiny satellite dish; a UFO work van.
Composition/framing: full vehicles in consistent elevated three-quarter front views, enough visible underside to understand the shape, each equally prominent. A small inset clean side-profile silhouette per panel beneath the main render for modeling clarity. Strong variation in silhouette and proportion. Small unobtrusive panel letters A, B, C, D only.
Lighting/mood: bright gentle daylight-like studio lighting, simple ambient shading, cheerful Saturday-morning cartoon comedy.
Color palette: desaturated mint, lavender, warm coral, teal, cream and butter yellow with dark blue-gray details, simple materials.
Constraints: every craft must have an unmistakable circular flying-saucer silhouette, a compact cockpit and simple readable rim; large recognizable forms rather than intricate machinery. Original designs. No aliens or human figures in this sheet. No weapons, no spikes, no aggressive silhouettes, no ominous glowing tractor beams, no chrome photorealism, no dense sci-fi greebles, no smoky atmosphere, no spacescape, no logos, no watermark, no extraneous text.
